scope: Checked source-only row-to-scene grouping and connected recurring-cast correspondence control

checks.subsequent_test_strengthening: Row remap asserted against independently constructed parented Unit identities; passing mutation baselines and Ruff

construction.grouping: Exact union retains source gaps; new parent identity is exposed in old-to-new row map; source-only and unparented-row preconditions
construction.recall_intake: All raw characters including separators covered; semantic quotes retain exact token support

computed_structural_controls.repeated_action: alternative PP rows despite differing manner
computed_structural_controls.changed_manner: QQ row retained with YY/ZZ diagnostics and no fidelity generated
computed_structural_controls.revisit: same source target with distinct recall occurrence

scripted_contract_controls: Supported/contradicted/gist-detail-error and external grades remain conditional
Same mapping and grading prompt bytes across reordered recalls; private occurrence/request identities differ
Fixed-question counts: 3 total, 3 expressed, 2 resolved; no conversion to grades

analysis.absence_meaning: No qualifying evidence under this policy; not independently proven omission

mutations.method: Isolated compiled mutants; each baseline 3 passing, mutant 1 named failure and 2 passing controls

installed_artifact.environment: Python 3.12.11 wheel site-packages import outside checkout, PYTHONPATH unset
installed_artifact.mapping_and_fidelity: Both methods replayed via CLI for all 9 units in each of 2 sessions (36 results)
installed_artifact.analysis_and_claim_verification: Passed for both final session artifacts

independent_review.verified: Source-only boundaries, exact union, identity remap, non-unit graph preservation, artifact readback, coverage ablation, grant ordering and evidence limits

limits: Direct-reference and fidelity replies are scripted, not provider accuracy evidence
Matching cast labels are lexical evidence, not inferred cross-unit coreference
One-level source grouping is not full narrative hierarchy
Full P2-P6, richer source/recall projections, event/episode targets, semantic channels and account-derived sequence inference remain owed
